hero.description: Looking down the driveway toward the site of Werowocomoco, located at the end of Ginny Hill Road west of Gloucester Courthouse in Gloucester County, Virginia, United States.  Now owned by the National Park Service, the site is an archaeological site and has been listed on the National Register of Historic Places.

gallery.title: File:Detail of Powhatan at Werowocomoco on John Smith's map. (a3fcb4d3-0e9b-4688-bff8-4c2dc9940257).jpg
gallery.description:
An illustration depicting Paramount Chief Powhatan's longhouse. Powhatan sits in the center back on a raised platform wearing a feather headdress and necklaces and holding a long pipe. Two figures sit on either side of him. On the floor below, twenty figures sit in four rows on mats around a central fire where food is cooking. A caption reads, "POWHATAN Held this state & fashion when Capt. Smith was delivered to him prisoner 1607".
A detail of John Smith's map depicting Paramount Chief Powhatan's longhouse. The caption reads, "POWHATAN Held this state & fashion when Capt. Smith was delivered to him prisoner 1607".
Keywords: Powhatan; Captain John Smith; Map
